summary: Double splitter in the style of frexp: given a double a1, writes the base-2 exponent into *a2 and returns the normalized mantissa. Handles zero, subnormals (via an explicit normalization loop seeded at exponent -1021), and the normal branch (exponent recovered as (mantissa-field >> 4 & 0x7FF) - 1022). Both nonzero branches call FloatBitManipulation(a1, 0) to build the returned mantissa. Called by sub_5919DA.

operations.description: If a1 == 0.0, take the zero branch: exponent 0, mantissa 0.0.
If a1 is a subnormal (exponent field of a1 is 0 and the mantissa bits are nonzero), take the normalization branch.
Seed v2 = -1021 for the subnormal branch and capture the sign of a1 (v3 = a1 < 0.0).
While bit 4 of the upper mantissa byte is clear, double a1 (scaled) and decrement v2, normalizing the subnormal mantissa.
Clear the normalization bit from a1's mantissa and restore the sign bit from v3.
Call FloatBitManipulation(a1, 0) to obtain the normalized mantissa v5.
Normal branch: v5 = FloatBitManipulation(a1, 0) and v2 = ((a1 mantissa-field >> 4) & 0x7FF) - 1022.
Write the exponent into the caller's slot: *a2 = v2.
